title: Unraveling the Allosteric Cross-Talk Between Coactivator Peptide and Ligand Binding Site in Glucocorticoid Receptor
authors: Giuseppina La Sala; Anders Gunnarsson; karl edman; Christian Tyrchan; anders hogner; Andrey Frolov
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究糖皮质激素受体配体与共激活肽间的变构串扰，虽涉及蛋白-配体/肽互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Glucocorticoid receptor (GR) is a nuclear receptor that controls critical biological processes by regulating the transcription of specific genes. There is a known allosteric cross-talk between the ligand and coregulator binding sites within the GR ligand binding domain that is crucial for the control of the functional response. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying such an allosteric control remain elusive. Here, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, bioinformatic analysis and biophysical measurements are integrated to capture the structural and dynamic features of the allosteric cross-talk within GR. We identified a network of evolutionarily conserved residues that enables the allosteric signal transduction, in agreement with experimental data. MD simulations clarify how such network is dynamically interconnected and offer a mechanistic explanation of how the different peptides affect the intensity of the allosteric signal. This study provides useful insights to elucidate the GR allosteric regulation, ultimately, posing the foundation for designing novel drugs.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素受体（glucocorticoid receptor, GR）是一种核受体，通过调控特定基因的转录来控制关键生物过程。已知在GR配体结合域内，配体与辅调节因子结合位点之间存在变构交叉对话，这对功能反应的调控至关重要。然而，这种变构控制背后的分子机制仍不明确。本研究整合了分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟、生物信息学分析和生物物理测量，以捕捉GR内变构交叉对话的结构和动态特征。我们识别出一个进化上保守的残基网络，该网络能够实现变构信号转导，这与实验数据一致。MD模拟阐明了该网络如何动态互联，并提供了不同肽段如何影响变构信号强度的机制性解释。本研究为阐明GR变构调控提供了有价值的见解，最终为设计新型药物奠定基础。
